title: Oren's First Steel
summary: Oren will teach you to make a blade. Bring him 6 raw iron, 6 raw copper and 8 coal.
ask: Oren: I'm Oren, the smith. Most hunters buy cheap blades off a cart, and they snap the first time they hit bone.
Oren: If you want a blade that lasts, make it yourself. I'll teach you how, once.
Oren: Bring me 6 raw iron, 6 raw copper and 8 coal, and we'll light the forge.

steps.text: Bring Oren 6 Raw Iron from the hills
done: Oren: Iron. Good iron, even. Don't let it go to your head. The hills did the work.

steps.text: Bring Oren 6 Raw Copper from the river cuts
done: Oren: Copper, for the guard and the rivets. That'll do.

steps.text: Bring Oren 8 Coal for the fire
done: Oren: Now the fire. Watch the colour, not my face. My face is always like this.
Oren: There. That's a blade. Ugly, but honest. Now it needs tempering, and you're doing that yourself, at a Forge or at mine.

steps.text: Temper a blade at a Forge, or with Oren
done: You feel the edge settle. It rings a little longer than it did.
Oren: Hm. Hm. Give it here. ...Fine. It's fine. It's better than fine and I'm not saying it twice.
Oren: Take my mark. Anything you temper from now on starts a step ahead. Don't make me regret it.
